decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to maintain control of the game tempo. By reanimating powerful creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Grief, the deck can apply early pressure while using cards like Force of Will and Daze to protect its threats. The inclusion of cards like Brainstorm and Ponder allow for card selection and manipulation, ensuring the deck maintains consistency. The deck's combination of aggro and tempo elements makes it a versatile and powerful option in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly generate mana and spells to build up a large storm count and then finish the game with a powerful Grapeshot. The deck aims to use rituals and fast mana sources to cast multiple spells in one turn, drawing through the deck with cards like Wheel of Misfortune, Echo of Eons, and Reforge the Soul to generate a lethal amount of storm and finish the opponent off with Grapeshot. Defense Grid helps protect the combo from disruption, while Burning Wish can be used to grab the necessary pieces from the sideboard.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the tempo of the game while using powerful creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Questing Druid to apply consistent pressure on the opponent. The deck utilizes card advantage and efficiency with cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Mishra's Bauble to maintain a strong board presence. Counterspells like Force of Will and Daze are used to protect your threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. This deck focuses on a fast and efficient strategy to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy using a combination of efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck aims to quickly deploy threats and protect them with counter magic while also utilizing card selection and manipulation with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder. The mana base is streamlined to support the deck's aggressive tempo strategy, allowing for quick resource denial and consistent threats.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly play out artifacts while disrupting your opponent with cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will. Emry, Lurker of the Loch is a key piece in recurring artifacts from the graveyard, while Urza's Saga provides additional artifact tokens. Card draw power is provided by Mishra's Bauble and Thoughtcast. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive artifact creatures like Patchwork Automaton and Kappa Cannoneer, backed up by powerful artifacts like Shadowspear and Aether Spellbomb. It is a fast-paced aggro deck with a blue artifact theme.

The main focus of this Legacy Canadian Threshold deck is to maintain tempo and control through aggressive tactics, utilizing powerful spells like Lightning Bolt, Force of Will, and Daze to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to quickly develop a board presence with creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler while also utilizing cards such as Ponder and Brainstorm for card selection and advantage. The inclusion of cards like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower add versatility and additional threats to apply pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to win through a balance of aggression and disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively disrupt your opponent's mana base using cards like Blood Moon, Chalice of the Void, and Ancient Tomb while quickly deploying powerful threats like Broadside Bombardiers and Stingerback Terror. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with high-impact creatures and disruptive spells, utilizing the fast mana provided by cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to accelerate its game plan. The inclusion of cards like Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance also provide additional threats to close out the game efficiently.

This Dragon Stompy deck focuses on quickly locking down opponent's lands with Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void, while also presenting aggressive threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Broadside Bombardiers. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure to end the game quickly. With efficient mana acceleration like Chrome Mox and City of Traitors, the deck can quickly overpower opponents before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Shatterskull Smashing provide additional value and flexibility in different situations.

This deck focuses on utilizing Gaea's Cradle to generate mana and ramp up quickly, allowing for the early deployment of threats like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Craterhoof Behemoth. It also includes cards like Endurance and Collector Ouphe to disrupt opponent strategies and control the board. The deck utilizes Green Sun's Zenith and Natural Order to tutor for key creatures, while cards like Fiend Artisan and Elvish Reclaimer offer flexibility and graveyard recursion. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through mana advantage and powerful creature synergy.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying artifacts and generating card advantage while putting pressure on the opponent. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Saga are key pieces in this strategy, allowing for recurring artifacts and creating powerful token creatures respectively. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will to control the opponent's game plan. With a mixture of fast mana sources and efficient threats, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own strategy.

This Control deck focuses on manipulating the game through card draw, counterspells, and removal, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Relic of Progenitus. It aims to control the board and tempo of the game, ultimately leading to victory through incremental advantage and resource management. The deck also utilizes a variety of lands to fix mana and disrupt the opponent's mana base, while also incorporating a win condition in the form of Lórien Revealed.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, using cards like Entomb and Grief. Then, utilizing cards such as Reanimate and Animate Dead, to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for a quick and powerful attack. The deck also includes disruption elements like Brainstorm, Daze, and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's plans. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and resilient threats while controlling the game.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void while quickly deploying aggressive threats like Broadside Bombardiers and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Using fast mana acceleration from cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and denial effects like Trinisphere. The deck also includes burn spells like Fury and Shatterskull Smashing for additional reach and removal.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill up your graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Grief, and then bring them back into play with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. By utilizing powerful reanimation spells and disruptive cards like Dauthi Voidwalker, the deck aims to overwhelm and surprise the opponent with big threats like Archon of Cruelty while protecting its strategy with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. Utilizing a mix of disruption, card advantage, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to win the game through fast, explosive plays.

The main focus of this Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's mana base and lock them out of casting spells with cards like Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void. By utilizing fast mana sources like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox, the deck aims to deploy threats such as Broadside Bombardiers and Goblin Rabblemaster to apply pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of powerful dragons like Fury and Shatterskull Smashing, along with utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance, further enhance the deck's aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly casting cascade spells like Violent Outburst to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures like Endurance and Crashing Footfalls. It uses a combination of mana acceleration from Simian Spirit Guide and Elvish Spirit Guide, along with disruptive elements like Force of Will and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to be aggressive and proactive, using cards like Shardless Agent and Brazen Borrower to keep the pressure on the opponent while controlling the board with Lórien Revealed and Brazen Borrower.
